evidenceInputs: existing D-series or witness packet references when available
advisoryCapabilities.mayDo: Detect candidate EML-shaped expressions or elementary-function surfaces for human review.
advisoryCapabilities.mustNotSay: The plugin proves the expression is correct or complete.
advisoryCapabilities.mustSay: Advisory detection only; no completeness, correctness, or target-readiness claim.

advisoryCapabilities.mayDo: Record static cost/profile hints when local metadata is available.
advisoryCapabilities.mustNotSay: The hint predicts realized training cost or runtime performance.
advisoryCapabilities.mustSay: Static hint only; no measured runtime, savings, or performance claim.

advisoryCapabilities.mayDo: Suggest that a reviewer inspect a candidate rewrite or guard-bearing identity.
advisoryCapabilities.mustNotSay: The plugin may safely replace or lower code.
advisoryCapabilities.mustSay: Review suggestion only; no automatic rewrite or semantic-preservation claim.

advisoryCapabilities.mayDo: Surface domain, guard, and blocked-claim obligations next to a candidate expression.
advisoryCapabilities.mustNotSay: The presence of a guard note establishes the guard.
advisoryCapabilities.mustSay: Guard reminder only; no proof or proof-carrying artifact claim.

advisoryCapabilities.mayDo: Link a candidate expression to existing private evidence packets or checked witnesses when present.
advisoryCapabilities.mustNotSay: Every relevant witness has been found or is public-ready.
advisoryCapabilities.mustSay: Evidence pointer only; no completeness, public readiness, or library coverage claim.

allowedOutputs.description: A private advisory warning for reviewer attention.
A short private note explaining why the expression may need review.
A static hint, clearly marked as non-runtime evidence.
A reminder that domain conditions or guards must be reviewed.
A link or id for an existing private evidence packet or witness.

blockedCompilerClaims.blockedClaim: The plugin or EML compiler is correct.
blockedCompilerClaims.reason: CPG-A1 contains no compiler implementation, proof, or end-to-end compiler validation.
Guard notes and rewrite hints are advisory and require separate checked evidence.

blockedCompilerClaims.blockedClaim: Automatic lowering or replacement is safe.
blockedCompilerClaims.reason: CPG-A1 authorizes no automatic lowering, replacement, or runtime mutation.

blockedCompilerClaims.blockedClaim: The plugin improves runtime, training cost, or performance.
blockedCompilerClaims.reason: Static hints are not runtime measurements and do not establish savings.

blockedCompilerClaims.blockedClaim: The plugin is ready across Python, Lean, hardware, or other targets.
blockedCompilerClaims.reason: Target readiness must be shown by target-specific evidence.
This artifact is private-first and contains no release validation.

blockedCompilerClaims.blockedClaim: EML is broadly advantaged over ordinary implementations.
blockedCompilerClaims.reason: One guard-note packet cannot establish broad comparative advantage.

blockedOutputs.description: Any emitted replacement code presented as safe.
Any proof or checked certificate claim created by the plugin.
Any runtime, training-cost, or performance measurement claim.
Any public-facing product or documentation claim.

nonClaims: CPG-A1 is a private guard-note packet only; it does not implement or execute a compiler plugin.
CPG-A1 records advisory lint/profile/guard-note boundaries only.

CPG-A1 does not claim compiler correctness, semantic preservation, automatic lowering safety, code generation correctness, runtime lowering safety, runtime performance, SDK stability, public readiness, or public package release readiness.

CPG-A1 does not claim training savings, estimator accuracy, scientific correctness, hardware readiness, silicon readiness, IP license readiness, accelerator-card readiness, reviewer approval, or broad EML advantage.
CPG-A1 respects the D109 hold and does not start D110, consume reviewer response, or touch laptop-owned electronics repositories.
reviewerQuestions: Which expression surfaces should produce advisory-only lint notes?
Which guard fields must exist before the plugin can suggest a rewrite review?
Which wording prevents users from reading advisory hints as compiler, proof, or performance claims?
Which existing evidence packet ids should be allowed as private evidence pointers?
